mentions.note: won the shield for the second year
likely to find his best form in the 20 miles walking championship
led early, a good 4th at 14 miles
won the individual title in 1921 while representing another club
walked as an individual Belgrave, fourth in 1924
one of the "usuals" on the Sunday strolls
